performance.verdict: No ads have ever launched; 5 overdue milestones are the real crisis.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages were all due 2026-07-31 — now 31 days overdue with no completed event recorded.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting were both due 2026-08-01 — 30 days overdue; $0 spend and 0 leads across all 28 days confirm neither is live.
GBP actions collapsed from ~9/day (2026-08-19 peak) to 0 for the last 3 full days (2026-08-28–30); 3-day signal is a confirmed downtrend inside an already thin 45-day baseline.
GHL shows 110 contacts and 17 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — with $0 paid spend, this suggests organic or direct contacts entering GHL but no intake converting them.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no paid spend can run until stack test and LSA verification are resolved.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are 30–31 days overdue: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting (all due 2026-07-31 or 2026-08-01). Zero spend and zero leads across the entire 28-day window confirm nothing is live. Success = each milestone marked complete with a verified artifact (e.g., LSA submission confirmation, live site URL, pixel test pass) by 2026-09-07. Sohib to confirm Nacer has a resolution date for each item.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 17 opportunities created, 0 appointments booked — identify where the 17 contacts are stalling and confirm intake routing is functional.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 110 contacts and 17 opportunities but 0 appointments and 0 won cases, indicating leads are entering the pipeline but not being routed or followed up correctly. Review stage-by-stage drop-off for all 17 opportunities and confirm the speed-to-lead automation (target: first contact under 5 min) is firing. Success = at least 1 appointment booked and a documented routing audit complete by 2026-09-07.

suggestions.text: Monitor GBP daily actions; if 0-action streak extends past 2026-09-03 (6 days), investigate profile suspension or visibility penalty.
